lead.headline: Binance Hit by Record $6.3B Hack as $5.8B Flees in 24 Hours
lead.tldr: The largest crypto theft in history exposed systemic vulnerabilities in exchange custody architecture, triggering immediate capital flight that tests whether user trust can be rebuilt through balance-sheet replenishment rather than structural reform.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, this week a single breach rewrote the ceiling for exchange risk and forced a live experiment in whether deploying corporate reserves can outrun user panic.

top_signals.title: Binance says phase one of withdrawals opens after $6.3B hack
top_signals.summary: Binance has initiated the first phase of user withdrawals following a record-breaking security breach. The hack resulted in a loss of approximately $6.3 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The phased withdrawal approach signals Binance is rationing liquidity to prevent a bank run, which means the $6.3B figure likely understates total insured and uninsured exposure still trapped on the platform.

top_signals.title: Inside the largest crypto hack on record: How attackers breached Binance for $6.3 billion
top_signals.summary: Attackers breached Binance's internal systems and wallet-signing mechanisms to execute the largest crypto hack in history. The breach resulted in the theft of $6.3 billion across multiple blockchains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Compromised wallet-signing mechanisms point to a failure in the core security assumption that multi-sig and cold storage adequately isolate privileged access, making this a template risk for every centralized custodian we underwrite.

top_signals.title: $6.3bn in 30 minutes: how the world’s biggest heist unfolded
top_signals.summary: North Korean hackers executed an unprecedented heist targeting Binance, stealing $6.3 billion in just 30 minutes. The attack represents one of the largest thefts in the history of digital assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A 30-minute execution window suggests reconnaissance and tooling sophistication that narrows the attribution to state-level actors, which implies this attack vector will be replicated against other exchanges rather than treated as a one-off.

top_signals.title: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
top_signals.summary: A massive $6.3 billion hack of Binance is being investigated, with experts analyzing the role of Ethereum's EIP-7702. While EIP-7702 is not cited as the primary cause, it may have amplified the resulting losses due to compromised signing systems.
top_signals.why_it_matters: EIP-7702's potential amplification of losses introduces a protocol-level liability question for Ethereum account-abstraction implementations, one that smart-contract auditors and DeFi insurers will now need to price explicitly.

top_signals.title: Binance net outflows surge to $5.8B as withdrawals resume after record hack
top_signals.summary: Binance experienced $5.8 billion in net outflows within 24 hours after resuming withdrawals following a massive $6.3 billion hack. While the exchange claims activity is stabilizing, the surge indicates significant user capital flight.
top_signals.why_it_matters: $5.8 billion in net outflows within 24 hours is a repricing event for Binance's implied deposit insurance; the exchange is now paying a liquidity premium that will compress lending margins and force higher yield offerings to retain sticky capital.

top_signals.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
top_signals.summary: Binance has replenished 90% of the assets lost in a massive $6.3 billion hack. The exchange aims to resume user withdrawals by Sunday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Replenishing 90% of stolen assets from corporate reserves is a balance-sheet flex that masks the real test: whether users differentiate between solvency and security, since the same infrastructure that was breached remains in operation.

deals.summary: Kalshi has raised $1 billion in funding, achieving a valuation of $40 billion. The company reports that its non-sports revenue run rate has surpassed $1.038 billion.
Money market fund fintech Spiko has successfully closed a $90 million Series B funding round. The company now holds a valuation of $800 million despite a challenging environment for European fintech.
Canton-based trading platform Cancore has raised $7.2 million in a seed funding round. The round was led by Paper Ventures and dao5 and was conducted via agreements for the upcoming CNRX token.

Bitcoin mining infrastructure provider Luxor has raised $16 million to facilitate its expansion into the AI infrastructure sector. The funding round was led by CMT Digital and consists of both new funding and share sales.
Y Combinator-backed Mochatrade has raised $5.5 million in a funding round led by CoinFund. The platform enables Indian traders to trade U.S. stock perpetual futures using Indian rupees.

on_the_radar.title: 바이낸스 63억 달러 해킹, 약속만으로 해결할 수 있는가?
on_the_radar.summary: The article discusses a massive $6.3 billion hack involving Binance and questions whether promises alone are sufficient to resolve the situation. It examines the implications of such a significant security breach on the exchange and the broader market.

on_the_radar.title: Binance founder says exchange targeted in apparent hack
on_the_radar.summary: Binance is investigating a security issue after its founder indicated the exchange was targeted in an apparent hack. In response, stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle have frozen billions of dollars worth of assets.

on_the_radar.title: Binance investigating hack as suspicious outflows reach up to $5.8 billion
on_the_radar.summary: Binance is investigating a potential security breach following the detection of suspicious outflows. On-chain data indicates massive movements, with up to $5.8 billion involved in suspicious activity.

on_the_radar.title: Binance investigates potential multibillion-dollar hack
on_the_radar.summary: Binance is currently investigating reports of a potential security breach involving a multibillion-dollar hack. A company spokesperson confirmed that the exchange is looking into the reported security issue.

on_the_radar.title: THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers
on_the_radar.summary: THORChain has halted swaps across 10 networks following the discovery of a refund bug triggered by an Ethereum block reorganization. This action has inadvertently hindered the movement of funds stolen in a massive $6.3 billion hack of Binance.

on_the_radar.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals following record hack
on_the_radar.summary: Binance experienced $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals following a record hack. The exchange stated these outflows represent 2.1% of its total assets and plans to release an updated proof-of-reserves report.

on_the_radar.title: NYSE Parent Signs Deal to Bring Compliant Hyperliquid Perps to U.S.
on_the_radar.summary: The parent company of the NYSE has signed a deal to launch compliant Hyperliquid perpetuals for the U.S. market. The U.S. venue will operate with its own separate liquidity pool, distinct from existing Hyperliquid markets.

on_the_radar.title: Binance hacker’s Bitcoin haul tops Coinbase’s corporate treasury19m, Binance hacker’s Bitcoin haul tops Coinbase’s corporate treasuryThe attackers held 18,270 BTC early Friday, topping Coinbase’s reported corporate holdings, and an Ether stash exceeding 500,000 ETH.
on_the_radar.summary: A hacker targeting Binance has accumulated a massive cryptocurrency haul that exceeds the corporate Bitcoin holdings of Coinbase. The attacker currently holds over 18,270 BTC and more than 500,000 ETH.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin slides below $77,000, BNB drops amid Binance hack
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin and BNB prices have declined following a security breach at Binance. Co-CEO Yi He has assured users that the exchange will reimburse all losses incurred from the hack.

on_the_radar.title: BlackRock joins SBI and Startale to link tokenized MMFs with Japanese yen stablecoins
on_the_radar.summary: BlackRock is partnering with SBI Holdings and Startale to explore the integration of tokenized money market funds with a Japanese yen-pegged stablecoin. This initiative aims to link traditional financial instruments with blockchain-based payment systems in the Japanese market.

on_the_radar.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
on_the_radar.summary: Ripple has received final approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to operate a national trust bank. This move allows the company to integrate more deeply into the US banking system.

on_the_radar.title: Strive closes in on second-largest corporate bitcoin treasury with $511 million purchase
on_the_radar.summary: Strive has significantly expanded its Bitcoin holdings with a $511 million purchase. This move positions the company as one of the largest corporate holders of Bitcoin globally.

worth_a_read.title: NYSE Parent Signs Deal to Bring Compliant Hyperliquid Perps to U.S.
worth_a_read.note: NYSE Parent's deal for compliant Hyperliquid perps signals how TradFi infrastructure providers are selectively onboarding DeFi-native instruments through regulated wrappers, which matters for timing when perpetual DEX volumes migrate onshore.

worth_a_read.title: This fintech wasn’t ‘actively’ fundraising. Then it closed a $90m round at an $800m valuation
worth_a_read.note: Spiko's passive fundraising success in a challenging European fintech climate offers a datapoint on where LP conviction still exists for tokenized money-market products with existing distribution.

worth_a_read.title: Weekly Research Brief: Binance Hacked; Hyperliquid on Wall Street; Prediction Markets’ Brazil ‘Miss’
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's brief bundles the Binance breach, Hyperliquid's Wall Street entry, and prediction-market regulatory misses into a single framework for how crypto risk and TradFi integration are accelerating in parallel rather than sequentially.

worth_a_read.title: Spark Token Holder Report Q3 2026
worth_a_read.note: Spark's Q3 token holder report provides the granular treasury and revenue metrics needed to stress-test whether DeFi protocol cash flows are stabilizing or still dependent on token emissions.

worth_a_read.title: ETHGas: Institutional Blockspace on Ethereum
worth_a_read.note: Delphi's institutional blockspace analysis maps how Ethereum's gas mechanics are being repriced by enterprise demand, which directly affects our underwriting of L2 strategies and rollup economics.

linkedin_post:
The Binance breach cost $6.3 billion and took thirty minutes. That is not the number that reprices the exchange. The repricing happens at $5.8 billion—net outflows in the first twenty-four hours after withdrawals resumed.

We have seen exchanges replenish hot wallets before. We have not seen one try to outrun a bank run while the same signing infrastructure that was exploited remains online. Binance claims ninety percent of stolen assets are backstopped by corporate reserves. That is a solvency claim, not a security claim. Users are voting with their deposits.

The testable question for our portcos and our LPs is whether retail and institutional depositors distinguish between balance-sheet depth and architectural overhaul. If outflows stabilize above pre-breach baseline, the market is pricing Binance as sufficiently capitalized despite unchanged custody risk. If the bleed continues, we are watching a live repricing of what 'too big to fail' means in crypto when there is no Fed backstop and no deposit insurance.

EIP-7702's role in amplifying losses adds a wrinkle. Account abstraction was supposed to reduce user error, not expand the attack surface for compromised signers. We are now underwriting Ethereum infrastructure with an explicit state-actor exploit in the reference case.

Our read: reserves buy time, not trust. And time is costing $5.8 billion per day.
